feature_extractor.model: OpenAI CLIP ViT-L/14 (open_clip arch 'ViT-L-14-quickgelu', pretrained='openai'), visual tower only, frozen

preprocessing.sampling: ffmpeg fps filter at feature_fps (frame nearest to t = k / feature_fps)

importance.note: Training-free scorer; no importance labels used (see README: licensing of TVSum/SumMe).

category.method: linear probe on [mean,max]-pooled CLIP features blended with CLIP zero-shot prompts
